Update for v11.9: include the overnight self-improving pipeline (overnight/self_improver.py, llm_client.py multi-provider fallback and rate-limit management, openrouter_quota.py, fix_backlog.json) where relevant.

Cover: 1) Hardware requirements (RAM, CPU, storage), 2) Docker compose stack (Wazuh, TheHive, Suricata, PostgreSQL+pgvector), 3) Network topology and port mappings, 4) Initial configuration steps, 5) Verification checklist. Write docs/OVERNIGHT_PIPELINE.md — full architecture and operations guide for the v11.9 overnight self-improving pipeline. Cover: overnight/self_improver.py (Phase A Gemini pre-fill, Phase B analysis with OpenRouter->Groq fallback, Phase C backlog drain); overnight/llm_client.py (multi-provider fallback chain, token-aware pacing, cooldown tracking, exponential backoff, rate-limit header pre-emption, model curation); overnight/openrouter_quota.py (50 RPD tracking, 24h lock, UTC rollover, atomic writes); disk-backed advisory queue and fix_backlog.json (crash resilience, decoupled analysis/fixing); the apply_auto_fix safety contract (pytest gate, .orig_backup crash recovery, git no-op detection, 120s timeout); cross-model validation (Gemini critique catches hallucinations). Include an operations runbook: launch commands, monitoring one-liners, budget checks, and safety guarantees (test-gated commits only, no network mutations).
